heading: Prune Summer Festival of Rewards Terms & Conditions

content.text: The Prune Summer Festival of Rewards Campaign is organised and promoted by Prune Payments Limited (Prune).
The Campaign will run from July 2026 to September 2026. Prune reserves the right to extend, amend or terminate the Campaign where necessary.

items: Be at least 18 years old and a legal resident of the United Kingdom.
Hold a valid Prune Payments account.
Reside in an eligible country where Prune services are available.
Comply with all applicable laws and Prune's Terms of Service.
Employees of Prune Payments and their immediate family members are not eligible.

items.heading: New Customers
items.text: New customers qualify after: downloading the Prune Payments App; completing KYC verification; and successfully completing their first money transfer.

items.heading: Existing Customers
items.text: Existing customers qualify by completing cumulative transfers of £600 or more within a calendar month during the campaign period. Only successful and completed transfers qualify.

content.text: Eligible participants may receive rewards including but not limited to:

items: Other promotional rewards announced by Prune.

content.text: Reward availability is subject to stock and may change without prior notice.
Spin & Win Limit: Each eligible customer is entitled to one (1) spin of the Summer Wheel during the Campaign Period.
Rewards are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged for cash.
Eligible participants will automatically receive entries into the Grand Prize Draw.
Flights will be booked by Prune. Rewards are non-transferable and cannot be exchanged for cash.

items: Spin wheel rewards are determined by an automated, randomized algorithm.
Weekly and Grand Prize winners will be selected using Prune's approved internal winner selection process.
Respond within seven (7) business days of notification.

content.text: Failure to respond or provide valid documentation within the timeframe may result in forfeiture, and an alternate winner may be drawn.
By accepting a prize, winners agree that Prune may use their name, photograph, testimonial and video for promotional purposes without additional compensation, unless prohibited by law.
Prune reserves the right to disqualify any participant suspected of fraud, abuse, multiple accounts, chargebacks or any attempt to manipulate the Campaign.
Prune shall not be liable for technical failures, network interruptions, delayed entries or circumstances beyond its reasonable control.
Personal information collected will be processed in accordance with Prune's Privacy Policy and GDPR Guidelines solely for the administration of this Campaign.

items: Prune reserves the right to modify these Terms & Conditions at any time.
Participation constitutes acceptance of these Terms & Conditions.
